translations.web: As a roaring lion or a charging bear, so is a wicked ruler over helpless people.
translations.bsb: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.
translations.kjv: As a roaring lion, and a ranging bear; so is a wicked ruler over the poor people.
translations.asv: As a roaring lion, and a ranging bear, So is a wicked ruler over a poor people.
